stem.text: A sphere moves vertically downwards at terminal (constant) velocity in a liquid.
Which statement about the magnitude of the upthrust acting on the sphere is correct?

A.text: It is proportional to the acceleration of free fall.

B.text: It is equal to the weight of the sphere.

C.text: It is proportional to the density of the sphere.

D.text: It is proportional to the square of the radius of the sphere.
